name: video-digest
description: Turn talk videos - a YouTube playlist, a conference stream, or local files - into a shareable web digest: per-talk TL;DRs, takeaways, and slides paired with narration.

interface.longDescription: A five-stage pipeline: download and transcribe videos (yt-dlp + Whisper), segment long streams into individual talks, write per-talk TL;DRs and practical takeaways, pull the speaker's actual slides from the video and pair them with what was said, then build a digest site that deep-links back into the source video. Works from a YouTube playlist, a channel's streams tab, one long conference recording, a single talk, or a folder of local files.
defaultPrompt: Make a digest from this YouTube playlist: <url>
Digest this conference stream into per-talk summaries and slides
Add the new talks from that playlist to my existing digest
